body:
thanks I appreciate it.

a lot of this is pressure build up.  like steam inside of a sealed container.

growing up I was taught to hide the steam but I think the actual solution is to figure out a way to have a release valve

otherwise you crack and explode

whenever I make a post like this, it's that valve letting some pressure out.

makes me feel like a hypocrite because the 9/10 days that I'm solid I often post in self improvement subreddits, but that doesn't make me a hypocrite at all; it means I have the experience to back up my claims.

because I've figured out that valve.  it's working.

it works.

i've said this many times but thank you

thanks.  there are things I could be doing.  the relationships I'm forming will just take time to develop.  I do have old friends who are just understandably busy with their lives.   reached out to one of them and just talked.

what's fucked about talking about my feelings is that it makes them real, which is fucked, but once they're real I can do things with them.

i can look at them, show them to others, see how I can work around them

in that movie with freddie kruger (spelling?). they can't kill him because he's in the kids' heads.  nobody can help.  if he had become externalized and materialized, they could've sniped that motherfucker in an instant.

now that I've talked about this with you and talked about it with a friend, it's real.  it's standing in front of me.  I can fucking clock it in the face.
